The man appears afraid. Pressing him further, he admits fear, “I 
don’t think Gliere killed himself. Someone wanted him dead. 
Someone or something! I don’t know … It had to do with the 
Karpathos Device. Gliere kept saying that it must not go to Egypt.” 
Make a Persuade roll: if successful, go to 202; otherwise go to 87.
